testCases.title: Verify pagination controls are displayed
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
expectedResults: Pagination controls are displayed when there are more products than fit on one page.

testCases.title: Verify clicking a page number updates the product grid
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
Click on a specific page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show products for that selected page.

testCases.title: Ensure current page number is highlighted
steps: Navigate to the product display page.
Click on a page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The current page number is visually highlighted after navigating.
